attribution_scope: exact existing Claim scope retained in sidecar; no new canonical link column
deferred_attribution: sealable human outcome; blocks operational qualification

claim_node_links.authority: one exact sealed human attribution per link

no_op: exact rows are unchanged; conflicts fail; consumed package cannot execute again
baseline: registered target identity, byte hash, schema hash, full semantic snapshot
source_materialization: verified immutable content-addressed bytes outside native execution inventory; rechecked before commit
authorization: qualification is not execution authorization; external operator registers exact envelope and target, then explicitly confirms its identity
consumption: SQLite rollback-journal atomic transaction across registered target and isolated operator ledger; no canonical ledger/schema addition
receipt: immutable operator-ledger receipt committed with canonical rows and consumption; external receipt export failure is RECOVERY_REQUIRED until verified reconciliation
uncertainty: fail closed on missing/inconsistent ledger or canonical post-state; no blind retry
web: read-only canonical access; Workbench-only mutations; no privileged entry import, process spawn or apply route
receipt_registration: operator verifies ledger, envelope and canonical post-state before registering immutable receipt in Workbench; HTTP reconciles only registered identity
privacy: HTTP exposes exact keys, safe field values and hashes for withheld private Source metadata; operator inspection exposes complete qualified rows
stage2_execution_scope: disposable canonical database qualification only; real Production execution requires separate authorization
